After they bought the big red ball, Tim played with it all day. He was very happy and had lots of fun. Then, it was time to go home. Tim promised his mom he could always remember the fun store with his big red ball.

One day, a boy named Tim went to the park. He saw a big red ball. He wanted to play with it. He took the ball and ran to it. The ball rolled far, far away. Tim ran to find the ball.
At the park, he met a girl named Sue. Sue's name was Sue. Sue said, "I like your ball. Can I play with it too?" Tim said, "Yes, let's play together!" They played with the ball and had lots of fun.
After playing, Tim and Sue were tired. They sat under a tree to rest. They talked about the day they found the ball. Tim said, "I had fun with my ball. Let's play again tomorrow." Sue said, "Bye, Tim. I had a great day with you." Tim went home happy and excited to see his new friend Sue again.
